[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-11l.5.1.2.1[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Arm %hold at launch submission[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A launch that carries `%hold` arms a durable hold as soon as it is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]submitted. For plain agent launches the runner arms the hold before[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]any dependency wait. For typed plans the hold is armed before any [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]unit dispatches. The hold then follows each unit to its runner or [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]proc without losing its original timing. It is released when a unit[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]never dispatches, and it survives every hand-off between processes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]The armer never holds its own kin, and a hold-carrying launch gets [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]an implied, non-authored priority boost.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202609/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]hold_launch_arming.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202609/hold_launch_arming.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim] Parent: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202609/hold_directive_surface.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-11l.5.1.2.1[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-11l/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]sase-11l.5.1.2.1.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rust hold store, launch armer, and wire support[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]hold-core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hold-core: add the `launch` armer kind, arm-time kin rejection, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]armer rebind to the Rust hold store. Add a pure launch-unit armer [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]builder and key helper, a `future` edge in the typed hold-cycle check, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and a waiting-marker wire that keeps "absent" separate from "false" for [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`wait_priority_explicit`. Add pyo3 bindings and bump the core pin.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Python hold facade and launch-hold primitives[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]hold-facade[dim] · [dim][/dim]after hold-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hold-facade: extend the facade with an explicit armer and selectors, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rebind, a shared TTL resolver, and `launch`-kind validation and liveness[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](a receipt only counts once it is complete). Add `launch_hold.py` with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the key, armer, arm, pre-arm, rebind, re-anchor, and release primitives,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plus `HOLD_ARMER_WAIT_PRIORITY`. The CLI reuses the TTL resolver.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Pre-arm typed plans and follow units to dispatch[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]typed-arm[dim] · [dim][/dim]after hold-facade[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]typed-arm: pre-arm hold-carrying units under the admission lock, with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]idempotent per-unit markers and rollback on failure. The coordinator [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]re-anchors the holds before it acks startup. Agent dispatch passes the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]key and re-anchors the hold to the spawned runner; proc dispatch rebinds[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the hold to the proc. Units that never dispatch release their hold, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]proc candidates and proc capacity admission use the key and the implied [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]priority.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Arm or rebind in the agent runner bootstrap[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]bootstrap-arm[dim] · [dim][/dim]after hold-facade[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bootstrap-arm: carry the parsed hold on AgentInfo. Arm a fresh agent [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hold, or rebind the SASE_LAUNCH_HOLD_KEY pre-arm, right after directive [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]extraction; skip refresh passes and retry handoffs, and scrub the env [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]var. Thread an implied hold priority through runner-slot admission as [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]non-explicit, and make the TUI wire enrichment honor an explicit false.[/#D7D7AF]
